Local DJs, Bhangra Dance Troop, Live Saxophone, Upscale Cocktail Lounge, Hookah & more

About this Event

Local ATX talent. Desi culture. One big Diwali night.
This Diwali, Desi Vibe Tribe is bringing together some of the people shaping our South Asian scene for a celebration built right here at home.

On the decks: Gabru • Slayjal • Rahul
Live sax: Ananto
On the Mic: Harsh
Dance Workshop & Performance: ATX Bhangra

Expect Bollywood, Punjabi and Desi favorites, live performances, and non-stop entertainment!
Plus enjoy henna, a 360° photo booth, craft cocktails, hookah, tasty bites, and festive energy!

And we're especially excited to be back at Busy Signal.
Hidden away on East 11th, the historic speakeasy blends Austin music history with a stylish, intimate lounge atmosphere & outdoor patio - exactly the kind of space we wanted for this year's Diwali celebration. Busy Signal

But what makes this night different is simple:
We're celebrating the talent, performers, creators and community we have right here at home.

DRESS CODEFESTIVE / INDO-WESTERN
Come dressed up. Bring your people. Meet some new ones.

FRI, NOV 6 • 9 PM ONWARDS
BUSY SIGNAL • 1104 E 11TH ST, AUSTIN 78702
21+
